When extract_images is false, conversion still succeeds and inline images are not extracted

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"extract_images\":false}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Text with <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==\" alt=\"pixel\"> image.</p>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
